never: index a file that is not on the register
name a team as an owner
put customer material in the shared index
return a composed answer from search
hand the graph a source the register does not hold
promote an entry to the graph with no person in promoted_by
stays_with_person: owning a source, and answering for it when it moves
closing a gap for a source that cannot be found
who may read customer material and for how long
promoting a register entry to the graph

provider_block.job: everything the business relies on, in one place, with a name on it

with_us.note: No hosted step. The production check runs over the business's real drive and mailbox with its real owners. The watch is the part not to hand-roll: a scheduled re-fetch and checksum compare of every source, with the owner told when it moves. It is a schedule and a table, not a product.

checks.title: Every source is on the register before anything is indexed
Duplicates resolve to one canonical copy, and only the canonical is indexed
Every source has a named owner, and a team is not an owner
Retrieved date, checksum and edition are recorded when the source arrives
Customer material is registered as such, restricted, and kept out of the shared index
Every indexed passage names its source and a locator that can be opened
Search returns passages with their source and locator, and composes nothing
A source that should exist and cannot be found is a gap with an owner and a date
Every source on the drive is re-fetched on a schedule, and a changed checksum reaches its owner
Retention and access follow the kind of source
A source reaches the graph only from the register, carrying its id, edition, checksum and locator scheme
